mara.activity: Wake slowly, drink water, check how I feel, and sit on the edge of the bed before standing. Leave my reading glasses on the nightstand.
mara.intention: Start gently and avoid spending energy before I know how I feel.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, and change into lounge pants and an evening sweater rather than getting dressed for work.
mara.intention: Be comfortable and accept that today is another recovery day.

mara.activity: Make tea with lemon and honey, carry the mug to the kitchen island, and eat yogurt with a banana while sitting quietly.
mara.intention: Get fluids and a little food in me without cooking.

mara.activity: Send one brief message to the studio confirming that I am still ill and unavailable, then put my phone down.
mara.intention: Close the loop without inviting a work conversation or making decisions.

mara.activity: Return to the main bedroom and rest in bed with the lights low, keeping water within reach. Doze if I can.
mara.intention: Give the illness the uninterrupted rest it is asking for.

mara.activity: Wake, drink water, and sit on the edge of the bed before moving to the living room.
mara.intention: Move slowly and check whether standing makes the fogginess worse.

mara.activity: Sit on the living room sectional with my paperback book. Stop reading as soon as the words lose their shape.
mara.intention: Have quiet company without forcing concentration.

mara.activity: Make a fresh mug of tea and carry it to the kitchen island, then rinse the mug and leave the immediate sink area orderly.
mara.intention: Keep myself hydrated and do only the smallest useful household task.

mara.activity: Rest on the living room sectional with my phone nearby for essential messages only.
mara.intention: Stay out of bed for a change of position without attempting work.

mara.activity: Prepare toast and scrambled eggs slowly at the kitchen island, then eat from the plate without setting the dining table.
mara.intention: Have a substantial but manageable meal before the afternoon rest.

mara.activity: Carry the plate and skillet to the sink, wash them, and wipe only the part of the island I used.
mara.intention: Prevent a small mess from becoming tomorrow's problem, without cleaning the kitchen.

mara.activity: Take a long quiet rest in the main bedroom with the phone on silent and water nearby.
mara.intention: Protect the afternoon for recovery instead of trying to reclaim a normal schedule.

mara.activity: Wake, drink water, and sit on the edge of the bed before moving to the living room.
mara.intention: Reassess gently and avoid committing to the evening meeting.

mara.activity: Send the community garden committee a short cancellation message, explaining that I am still ill, then put my phone away.
mara.intention: Abandon the meeting clearly rather than carrying guilt about it through the evening.

mara.activity: Sit quietly on the living room sectional and rest with the lights softer.
mara.intention: Let the cancelled plan remain cancelled and conserve energy for dinner.

mara.activity: Prepare another simple dinner of toast and scrambled eggs at the island, carrying the plate and a mug to my place as I finish each item.
mara.intention: Feed myself simply while Julian is occupied with his evening shift.

mara.activity: Eat seated at the island, drinking tea and water, without trying to hold a conversation or make decisions.
mara.intention: Keep dinner quiet and undemanding.

mara.activity: Rinse the dinner things, wash the skillet, and wipe the island clear enough for tomorrow.
mara.intention: Finish the necessary cleanup while I still have a little energy.

mara.activity: Rest on the living room sectional, answering only essential messages if they arrive.
mara.intention: Have a low-stimulation evening rather than attempting music, reading, or household planning.

mara.activity: Make one last mug of tea, carry it to the bedroom, and drink it while sitting quietly on the bed.
mara.intention: Settle my throat and prepare for an early night.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, change into sleep pants and a sleep shirt, and put my phone on its charger.
mara.intention: Finish the day without adding any more tasks.

mara.activity: Get into bed, place my reading glasses on top of the nightstand, and read only a few pages before turning out the light.
mara.intention: Use a familiar, quiet ritual and stop before concentration fails.

mara.activity: Sleep.
mara.intention: Allow a full night for recovery.

julian.activity: Wake beside Mara, drink water, and lie still for a few minutes while quietly checking how she is feeling.
julian.intention: Start gently and notice whether Mara needs anything before I begin the day.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and dress in work trousers, a restaurant shirt, wool socks, and kitchen clogs.
julian.intention: Get ready without making the morning noisy or demanding.

julian.activity: Make tea with honey and a small yogurt-and-banana bowl, carry them to the kitchen island, and leave a covered portion nearby for Mara if she wants it later.
julian.intention: Offer something mild and easy while keeping food available without pressuring her.

julian.activity: Drink coffee and eat a little breakfast at the island, then sit quietly with my piano music book for a few minutes.
julian.intention: Have a familiar, low-decision pause before work while listening for Mara.

julian.activity: Pack my backpack with water, phone, reading glasses, tablet, and a paperback book; collect my keys from the piano middle shelf and put on my jacket.
julian.intention: Leave prepared for the long split shift and send Mara a practical check-in before I go.

julian.activity: Travel to the restaurant and handle deliveries, prep, stock checks, and kitchen management.
julian.intention: Complete the first kitchen shift carefully, especially the Wednesday inspection and stock details.

julian.activity: Return home, set my backpack beside the kitchen island, bring the thermos to the sink, and check quietly on Mara.
julian.intention: Make sure Mara is settled before I rest and note anything she needs for later.

julian.activity: Take a quiet nap and reset in the main bedroom.
julian.intention: Recover enough energy for dinner service while keeping the room calm.

julian.activity: Make a small pot of gentle tomato-and-carrot soup, leave a covered bowl on the kitchen island, and eat a little myself.
julian.intention: Leave Mara a safe, simple option for the evening and get some food into myself before service.

julian.activity: Rinse the stockpot and bowl, refill the thermos, collect my backpack and keys, and send Mara one final practical message before leaving.
julian.intention: Leave the kitchen usable and Mara supported without extending the goodbye.

julian.activity: Travel to the restaurant, run dinner service, and complete closing duties.
julian.intention: Stay focused through the Wednesday evening service and close methodically rather than rushing.

julian.activity: Travel home, bring the thermos into the kitchen and set it beside the sink, drop my wallet and earplugs on the living room coffee table, and check that Mara is settled.
julian.intention: Come in quietly, follow my usual post-service landing routine, and make sure Mara is comfortable.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and change into sleep clothes without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Let the service noise fall away and keep the bedtime routine simple.

julian.activity: Eat a small portion of soup, drink water, put my phone on its charger, and return my wallet and earplugs to my pockets.
julian.intention: Settle my stomach and prepare to sleep without waking myself up further.

julian.activity: Get into bed beside Mara and sleep.
julian.intention: Rest for the next workday while remaining available if Mara needs me.
